samples.summary: The new `withUndoUnit` batching swallows the per-keystroke live-caret presence publish in docs-view
samples.evidence: `TextEditor.withUndoUnit()` now wraps the *whole* typing/paste/Enter/backspace body — including `this.cursor.moveTo(...)` — in `doc.batch()`. `cursor.moveTo` fires `fireCursorMoveCallbacks` synchronously (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1481), whose subscriber is `docs-view.tsx:465` / `:473` `store.updateCursorPos(pos, sel)`. `YorkieDocStore.updateCursorPos` ends with `if (this.skipNonHistoryPresence()) return;` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:3354, with `skipNonHistoryPresence()` = `this.activeRoot !== null`, :3379), so with a batch open the presence write is dropped and the caret peers see is left at whatever `recordHistoryPresence` staged (the *pre-edit* cursor consumed from `setCursorForHistory`, e.g. yorkie-doc-store.ts:1598-1602). Before this change those bodies ran outside a batch and the publish landed. docs-view's throttle only rescues the case where the call is deferred to `setTimeout` (:471); when >= CURSOR_UPDATE_THROTTLE has elapsed — i.e. ordinary typing cadence — the publish happens synchronously inside the batch and is lost. Fix belongs on the new code: publish (or re-publish) the caret after the outermost unit commits.

samples.summary: Backend design doc still documents only `GET /share-links/:token/resolve`; the new POST route the frontend now uses is undocumented
samples.evidence: docs/design/backend.md:323-327 describes `GET /share-links/:token/resolve` as the public resolve endpoint, and :552-554 describes its log redaction, but the frontend now calls `POST /share-links/resolve` exclusively (packages/frontend/src/api/share-links.ts:111). docs/design/sharing.md:53 was updated; backend.md was not. The top-level docs check only validates that backticked paths resolve on disk, so this drift is not caught by any lane.
